WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) as avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.brokrepstat, s1.avg_modelconf, s1.avg_modelconf - s2.overall_avg as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_modelconf > s2.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as step3_avg
  FROM step3
)
SELECT s3.brokrepstat, s3.avg_modelconf, s3.diff, s3.avg_modelconf / s4.step3_avg as ratio
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4 s4
WHERE s4.step3_avg IS NOT NULL
